timeline.q: How long does it take to receive a shortlist?
timeline.a: Ten business days from an approved role brief for the first shortlist, and usually one to three weeks to a signed offer depending on the profile. You see applicants in your pipeline as they arrive, not only at the end.

contactDetails.q: When do I see a candidate's contact details?
contactDetails.a: After Dexee releases them for a specific application, which happens once you decide to interview. Until then you see the professional profile, the verification report and the assessment results, identified by reference.

classification.q: Contractor or employee, and who carries the classification risk?
classification.a: With Dexee as employer of record, Dexee is the legal employer in Colombia, holds the contract and carries the employment obligations. With an independent contractor, the person contracts with you directly and you carry that relationship. We will tell you which one fits the role before you choose.

guarantee.q: What happens if the hire does not work out?
guarantee.a: Every placement carries a 90-day replacement guarantee, 120 days for founding clients. The window, the five exclusions, how to claim and the remedy are published in full, not summarized.

english.q: How do you verify English levels?
english.a: Written English is scored on the server. Spoken English is pre-scored by a model on four rubric dimensions and then a Dexee reviewer listens to the recordings and assigns the final CEFR level. The badge shows the lower of the two levels, never the flattering one.

ip.q: Who owns the intellectual property of the work?
ip.a: You do. The assignment of work product to the client is written into the employment or contractor agreement before the person starts, and it covers code, designs, documents and anything else produced for you. Ask us for the clause and your counsel can read it before you sign.

timezone.q: How much time-zone overlap will I get?
timezone.a: Colombia runs on UTC-5 all year, with no daylight saving. That is the same clock as US Eastern for most of the year and one hour ahead in winter, so a full working day overlaps with every US time zone.

dataProtection.a: Candidate data is processed under Colombia's Ley 1581 de 2012, with consent recorded at sign-up and a version stamped on the record. Contact details and resumes sit in restricted storage and reach a client only for an application they are interviewing for. A data processing agreement is available.

security.q: How are devices and information secured?
security.a: Under Dexee employment we can supply and manage the laptop, with disk encryption and a screen lock enforced. Access to your systems is yours to grant and revoke. We ask that offboarding runs through Dexee so access is cut the same day the engagement ends.

payment.q: What currency and payment method do you use?
payment.a: One invoice in USD, payable by bank transfer or ACH. Salaries are quoted in USD per month everywhere on this site. No local entity, no local bank account and no currency conversion on your side.

candidateCost.q: What do candidates pay, and why is it free?
candidateCost.a: Nothing, ever. Assessments, the profile and applying are free for candidates. Dexee is paid by the company that hires, which is the only arrangement under which a candidate can trust the result. A platform that charges candidates is selling them hope.

guarantee.windowBody: If a placed person leaves, or you end the engagement for performance, within {days} calendar days of their start date, Dexee replaces them at no additional fee. Founding clients have {foundingDays} days.

shortlist.label: Step 3
shortlist.body: On an accepted claim, Dexee presents the first replacement shortlist within {shortlistDays} business days, against the original role brief.

replace.label: Step 4
replace.body: You interview and select as you did the first time. There is no second placement fee, and the guarantee window restarts with the replacement.

guarantee.exclusionsIntro: The guarantee is a commitment about the person Dexee presented, not about changes on your side after they started. It does not apply when:

exclusions.roleChanged: The role changed materially from the brief Dexee sourced against, in scope, seniority or reporting line.
exclusions.noOnboarding: The person was not given the access, equipment or direction needed to do the work in the first three weeks.
exclusions.redundancy: The position was eliminated, put on hold or absorbed for budget or restructuring reasons.
exclusions.unpaidInvoice: A Dexee invoice for the engagement is more than thirty days overdue when the claim is filed.
exclusions.directOffer: The person was moved to a different role, entity or contract without Dexee being informed.

guarantee.remedyBody: The remedy is a replacement. If Dexee accepts a claim and does not present a shortlist within {shortlistDays} business days, you may take a credit for the placement fee against any Dexee service within twelve months, or ask for it back. Dexee does not limit its liability below the fee you paid for that placement.
guarantee.remedyNote: Nothing here limits rights you have under the law that applies to your contract.
guarantee.questionsBody: Send the terms to your counsel and write to us with what needs changing. Dexee would rather negotiate the language now than argue about it later.

verify.title: How we verify
verify.subtitle: Five checks before a candidate reaches your shortlist, and a person, not a model, assigns the English level.
verify.problemBody: Remote hiring across borders has an impersonation problem. It is documented, and it is the reason Dexee verifies before presenting, not after an offer.

evidence.checkr-impersonation-2025: 35% of 3,000 US hiring managers said someone other than the listed applicant took part in a virtual interview, and 23% reported losses above USD 50,000 in the past year from hiring or identity fraud.
evidence.gartner-fake-candidates-2028: Gartner projects that by 2028 one in four candidate profiles worldwide will be fake.
evidence.ftc-job-scam-losses: Reported losses from job and employment-agency scams in the United States rose from USD 90 million in 2020 to USD 501 million in 2024.

identity.title: Identity
identity.body: The candidate joins a live video session and shows a government ID. The reviewer compares the document with the person on the call and with the face that appears in the recorded English answers.
identity.produces: Verified or not verified, with the date of the session

spokenEnglish.title: Spoken English
spokenEnglish.body: The candidate records answers to unseen questions under a timer. The model pre-scores fluency, coherence, lexical range and grammatical accuracy out of five each. A reviewer then listens to the recordings and assigns the final level.
spokenEnglish.produces: A CEFR level from A1 to C2, with the four rubric scores
spokenEnglish.decidedBy: A human reviewer. The model only pre-scores

writtenEnglish.title: Written English
writtenEnglish.body: A timed assessment with multiple-choice items and a written response, scored on the server. The answer key never reaches the browser, so the score cannot be reverse-engineered from the page.
writtenEnglish.produces: A CEFR level and the raw score
writtenEnglish.decidedBy: Server-side scoring, reviewed when the two parts disagree

workProfile.title: Work profiles
workProfile.body: Two short instruments on public models: the Big Five with ten remote-work situations, and a four-factor DISC-style profile. Both describe how the person prefers to work.
workProfile.produces: Band descriptors per factor and a primary style
workProfile.decidedBy: Deterministic scoring. Never used to rank or reject

fit.title: Fit against the role
fit.body: The candidate's resume is read with contact data and protected attributes removed, then compared with the role brief, the profile and the valid results. Each applicant gets a score, a summary, strengths and gaps.
fit.produces: A ranked shortlist for the company: top 3 and top 5
fit.decidedBy: A model, as a recommendation. The company decides whom to interview

verify.humanTitle: What a model on its own cannot do
verify.humanBody: An automated screen can score a transcript. It cannot tell you whether the person on the call is the person who will do the work. A Dexee reviewer sits on the identity session, listens to the recorded answers and signs the final CEFR level. Where the reviewer disagrees with the model, the reviewer wins and the report says so.

humanPoints.impersonation: Identity is checked on a live call, against the same face that appears in the recorded answers.
humanPoints.override: The reviewer can move the English level up or down, and the report records who decided.
humanPoints.keys: Answer keys stay on the server, so a candidate cannot read them from the page.
humanPoints.reuse: A report is issued once per candidate and dated, so you know how fresh it is.

compare.sectionBody: Three comparisons that say plainly where the other option wins.

talent.heroTitle: Remote roles with US companies, from Colombia
talent.heroSubtitle: Build your profile once, take four free assessments, upload your resume and apply. Dexee protects your contact details until a company is serious.
talent.value1Body: Every vacancy shows the contract type and, in most cases, the monthly salary range in US dollars.
talent.value2Body: Companies see your profile and badges. Email, phone and resume are released by Dexee only when a company moves forward.
talent.value3Title: Formal employment when you want it
talent.value3Body: For Dexee as employer of record roles you get a Colombian employment contract with benefits, paid by Dexee.
talent.assessmentsTitle: Four free assessments, required to apply
talent.assessmentsIntro: Every candidate takes the same four before applying, so companies compare like with like. Results attach to your profile as Dexee screening badges, stay valid for 90 days, and travel with every application. They are not certifications.
talent.assessWrittenBody: 40 questions on grammar, vocabulary and reading plus one short writing task. 45 minutes. Automatic CEFR level.
talent.assessOralBody: Four recorded answers of 60 to 90 seconds. A Dexee reviewer validates the level, which then appears as verified.
talent.assessWorkstyleBody: Fifty statements and ten remote-work situations on the public Big Five model. You receive a full report; companies see band descriptors, never scores.
talent.assessDiscBody: Twenty-eight statements on the four-factor model of workplace behaviour. Your primary style and the environments that suit it. Context for a conversation, never a filter.
talent.assessmentsReceive1: A CEFR level for written and oral English, with feedback.
talent.assessmentsReceive2: Two work profiles, Big Five and DISC, with your strengths for remote work.
talent.assessmentsReceive3: Badges on your profile that companies can trust, and a fit analysis for every role you apply to.
talent.how1: Complete your profile, upload a PDF resume and take the four free assessments.
talent.how2: Apply to a role with one click and an optional note. Dexee analyses your resume and results against the role.
talent.how3: Track each application through screening, interview and offer.
talent.how4: Dexee releases your contact details when a company moves forward.
talent.faq1A: Yes. Companies pay Dexee. You never pay for assessments or placements.
talent.faq2Q: How long are results valid, and can I retake an assessment?
talent.faq2A: Results are valid for 90 days; after that you take the assessment again to keep applying. You can also retake one after its 90-day cooldown to improve it. Your latest valid result is the one companies see.
talent.faq3Q: Can I hide my work profiles?
talent.faq3A: Companies see band descriptors of your Big Five and DISC profiles by default, because they feed the fit analysis. You can hide either at any time in Settings; the fit analysis still runs on your full application.
talent.faq4A: Only what a hiring process needs: professional experience, skills, contact details and assessment results. Never photos, age or other protected characteristics.
talent.ctaBody: It takes about ten minutes. You can pause and continue later.

english_written.title: English written assessment
english_written.body: 40 multiple-choice questions on grammar, vocabulary and reading, plus one short writing task. You have 45 minutes from the moment you start. Your answers save automatically.
english_written.rule1: Find a quiet place and 45 uninterrupted minutes.
english_written.rule2: Do not use translators or outside help. The writing task is graded for your own English.
english_written.rule3: The timer keeps running if you leave the page. Submissions after the time limit exclude the writing task.
english_written.rule4: Your result is a CEFR level from A1 to C2 and appears on your profile as a Dexee screening badge.

english_oral.title: English oral assessment
english_oral.body: Four prompts. For each one you read the prompt, prepare for 20 seconds and record an answer of 60 to 90 seconds. You can re-record each answer once. A Dexee reviewer validates the level.
english_oral.rule1: Use a headset or a quiet room and allow microphone access when the browser asks.
english_oral.rule2: Speak naturally. The recording stops automatically at 90 seconds.
english_oral.rule3: You have 30 minutes to complete the four answers.
english_oral.rule4: Validated levels appear on your profile as verified by Dexee.

psychometric.title: Work-style profile
psychometric.body: Fifty statements about how you usually behave and ten short remote-work situations. There is no time limit and no right or wrong personality. Answer honestly.
psychometric.rule1: Rate each statement from very inaccurate to very accurate as it describes you.
psychometric.rule2: Choose the response you would most likely give in each situation.
psychometric.rule3: You receive a full report. Companies see band descriptors only if you enable sharing.
psychometric.rule4: This is a Dexee screening, not a clinical or certified assessment.

disc.title: DISC work profile
disc.body: Twenty-eight statements about how you act at work, across four styles. There is no time limit and no right or wrong style. Answer as you actually behave, not as you think a company wants.
disc.rule1: Rate each statement from very unlike you to very like you.
disc.rule2: You receive a full profile with your primary style and what environments suit it.
disc.rule3: Companies see descriptors only, never scores, and Dexee never ranks candidates by this profile.
disc.rule4: This is a Dexee screening built on the public four-factor model. It is not a certified DiSC assessment.

interview.title: Practice interview
interview.subtitle: Six written questions, feedback from Dexee's AI recruiter. Free, and a strong signal for our team when we shortlist.

intro.rule1: Six questions: four about your experience and two specific to the role.
intro.rule2: Answer in writing, about 60 to 150 words each. Concrete situations, actions and results score best.
intro.rule3: You have two hours; answers save as you type.
intro.rule4: You receive scores on communication, clarity of achievements, structure and relevance, plus recommendations. Dexee keeps the scores to match you with roles.
